scope: Frozen v30 on the complete already-consumed Mac paired regression, versus retained official Hi ESP P4 PCM results. Not independent or acoustic acceptance.
policy: Every manifest row in original order, whole original PCM after application zero prime, tail zeros only to complete 480-sample blocks. Reset and exactly replay each stream twice. No source/model/threshold selection from results.
event_accounting: Retain original float64 five-score convolution events and separately firmware double-sum/divide events. Convert one-based raw score step s to returning detector block end 480*(s+1), minus the prime. Keep any prime events separately, all original-source and padded-tail events, and every host/device-policy difference.
reports: Any-event and existing estimated-end [-100,+800] ms window by voice/variant; shared ordinary, Nyx-near, ESP-near and opposite-phrase groups separately. Estimated synthesis/RMS endpoints are not phonetic ground truth.
limits: All sources previously informed Mac development; 350 correlated clips do not establish new speaker coverage or final acceptance.
Hi ESP is a retained standalone P4 measurement; new v30 scoring is host INT8 reference with a separate one-fixture P4 agreement. Do not call this a 350-clip v30 P4 run.
Both engines have their own pinned zero-priming and block geometry; source PCM bytes remain unchanged. Neither source offsets nor estimated endpoints establish acoustic latency.
No new final/reserved data, speaker playback, microphone recording, USB/board/firmware, service permissions or production device operation.
